excerpt_original: The biennial will be titled ‘Forms of Inheritance’ and will be developed by local curatorial partners

blocks.caption: Graphic by An Endless Supply, adapted from EVA 1985 catalogue cover designed by David Lilburn

blocks.text: The 2027 edition of EVA International, Ireland’s Biennial of contemporary art, will be titled Forms of Inheritance . It will be developed with multiple Limerick-based curatorial partners including Askeaton Contemporary Arts, STARLING, Ormston House and Féile na Gréine. Further collaborators will be announced in Spring 2027.

Forms of Inheritance will consider and question values inherited from the past in the contemporary context, with specific attention to Ireland and its evolving relationship with Europe and the world. The exhibition will feature several new artist commissions. The commissions that have been announced are a work by Lisa Freeman responding to Story of the Celtic Tiger (2006) by Minerva Cuevas; a work by Dina Mimi tracing cross-generational solidarities between Irish Republican and Palestinian prisoners; and an installation by Sam Keogh based on an early-modern tapestry series that unsettles how Europe imagines itself.
Forms of Inheritance will take place across multiple venues in Limerick from 27 August to 24 October.
